# Node.js Express App - CI/CD Pipeline

This project is an automated CI/CD pipeline built using Node.js, GitHub Actions, and Docker Hub.

## Features
- **Node.js & Express** backend application
- **Dockerized** using Dockerfile
- **GitHub Actions** for automated build, test, and push to Docker Hub on every push to the `main` branch
